column1: # German (de) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (plural_one_other in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | other.
# Clean-room: entries are written from the meaning of PdfCraft's English labels using ordinary
# German computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied. Contributor-original, licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.
# Style: formal Sie in sentences, infinitive for commands; German spelling with ß.
# Terminology: Kommentar, Lesezeichen, Ebene, Schwärzen, Formularfeld, Einstellungen, Startseite.
# Product and technology names stay unchanged; placeholders, escapes and trailing … are retained.
